run_robot_agent_evaluation: run the robot agent evaluation in the OVMM simulation environment with a specified task goal
create_ovmm_simulation_env: create an OVMM simulation environment from habitat and env config YAML files
run_robot_exploration: run the RobotAgent exploration loop to find instances of a target object class
move_robot_to_object: move the robot agent to any found instance of a specified object class
grasp_object_with_funmap: grasp a target object using the FUNMAP grasp planner and SimGraspPlanner client
